Record Class SchemaSignature.Position

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.plugin.schema.SchemaSignature.Position
Record Components:
name - the position's name as the schema spells it, operand
kind - element or attribute
valueType - the type of value the position holds
minimum - the fewest values allowed, 0 for optional
maximum - the most values allowed, or UNBOUNDED
documentation - the schema's own description of this position on this type, empty when the schema gives none
Enclosing class:
SchemaSignature
public static record SchemaSignature.Position(String name, SchemaSignature.PositionKind kind, SchemaSignature.TypeReference valueType, int minimum, int maximum, String documentation) extends Record
One argument position of a type: a child element or an attribute, with the type of value it holds and how many of them the schema allows.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
